title: Arcatweaks
description: Various tweaks for the Arcamere modpack that did not fit into their own mod.
body:
Adds in blocks and features too small to justify their own mod, for the arcamere modpack

- Wood carvings, like shelves from the copper age but without the functionality
- Seed bags and crop crates in the style of farmer's delight
- Berry basket to store picked berries
- Music discs composed by Vuuren
- Throwable bricks that break glass
- Sharpness and fire aspect on tridents
